approved_by_user: 2026-10-30, option 'Separate add-on' chosen when asked how GROBID should enter RQ1
reason: rq1_rq4.json allowed GROBID only if it was available before Gate B (then 6 extractors would also define the keep rule). It was not available at Gate B; the user set it up afterwards.
unchanged: Cohorts C-INT, C-RET, C-RET-150, PEERQA-PDF and the version-check files (keep rule stays on the original 5 extractors)
The frozen RQ1-v2 primary family (4 challengers vs pymupdf_layout, Holm m=4) and its decision rule
The frozen extraction cache of the 5 original extractors

design.server: GROBID 0.8.2 CRF image (grobid/grobid:0.8.2-crf) via docker-compose.grobid.yml; protocol had named 0.8.0
design.endpoint: /api/processFulltextDocument, teiCoordinates=[p, head], one request at a time, timeout 300 s
design.tei_parsing: one block per body <div> (head = heading; paragraphs via itertext so inline <ref> citations do not truncate text); abstract first. The historical adapter in evaluate_rq1_extractors.py is not used (p.text truncation, page_count=1, 15 s timeout).
design.papers: same frozen papers and PDF versions as RQ1-v2: C-RET (primary), all opened reservoir papers except C-INT (sensitivity), C-RET-150 (downstream), PEERQA-PDF (descriptive). C-INT is never extracted.
design.primary: evidence recall, grobid - pymupdf_layout, paper-cluster paired bootstrap B=10,000 seed 42, single unadjusted test labelled post-Gate-B add-on
design.secondary: heading F1, client ms/page (HTTP to Docker/WSL2; not like-for-like with in-process extractors), failures (counted as recall 0), container memory via docker stats (~1-2 s sampling), downstream CEC@0.5 and nDCG@10 on C-RET-150 through the same pipeline as RQ1-v2
design.decision: GROBID cannot be adopted in this run. If it would meet the frozen switch rule (>= +0.03 with CI lower bound > 0), it is reported as a lead for future work, not as a winner.

deviations_before_registration: Smoke test on 3 papers (output in rq1v2_grobid_addon/smoke_3, not used for decisions) found that in --limit mode the downstream papers were not extracted and scored 0; fixed by extracting them and reporting papers without units. No full-cohort outcome was seen before this registration.
